capabilities: Reorder files and folders within the same parent by drag and drop
Move files into folders via drag to folder center
Persist per-folder custom order in plugin data
Toggle custom ordering on and off via ribbon icon or command
Reset all saved custom ordering to default sort
disambiguation: Not a renaming or sorting tool; it changes display order only and never modifies filenames.
extras: Installable via BRAT or manually; desktop only (tested on Windows) and requires Obsidian 1.7.2+ because it uses internal vChildren and InfinityScroll APIs. Order is stored in data.json, so it is lost if plugin data is cleared.
intentEvidence: Reorder files and folders in Obsidian's File Explorer using drag and drop.
problem: Obsidian's File Explorer has no manual ordering, so users resort to filename prefixes or other hacks to keep notes in a chosen sequence.
summary: Drag-and-drop tool that reorders files and folders in the File Explorer, storing the custom order in plugin data without renaming files.
